svg.title: Friends: search, send a request, and recipient actions
svg.desc: Jamie searches for al, matching usernames by case-insensitive substring and excluding Jamie's own account. Alex appears with a Send request button. After sending, the button is disabled and reads Request pending; Jamie is not yet friends with Alex. Only one pending request is allowed per account pair. Separate state examples show an existing friend disabled, an outgoing request disabled, and an incoming request linking to the inbox rather than creating a reciprocal request. Alex's inbox shows Jamie's pending request, with Accept and Decline as supporting actions outside the send goal. Self-requests are blocked. Privacy policy is not specified here.
svg.text: Main goal: send a friendship request. Sending is not acceptance.

g.text: 1 · Jamie's view — search directly from Friends
Request sent to Alex. Awaiting their response.
Disabled: cannot send a duplicate. Alex is not yet in Jamie's friends list.

g.aria-label: Alternative result states, not additional search results
g.text: Separate states, not a result list. One pending request per account pair.

g.aria-label: Recipient inbox: supporting accept and decline actions
g.text: Pending request from Jamie · username: jamie
Outside the send goal: Accept establishes friendship; Decline does not.
Neither action has happened in this example. The request remains pending.

svg.text: Search excludes the sender; self-requests are blocked. Incoming requests open the inbox.
No reciprocal request is created. Privacy policy is not specified by this drawing.
